reviews.text: Absolutely love Salon 6, Lori/Andy and everyone is so great! Been going there for almost 10 years and Lori is my girl, not only super talented but a hoot to spend time with, love her so much! I always walk out super happy and rejuvenated inside and out.

I've been coming to Salon 6 for 3 years now and it never disappoints! 🤩I love the atmosphere and everyone is so nice☺️Wanna give a special shoutout to Carolina for her amazing work as you can see she's an artist!

Lori is simply the best!
From color to cut she gives you the best. She will be honest and tell you what you need and I love her for it!
